title: PsMyBackup Snapshot Status
description: Schema for backup-status.json generated by PsMyBackup.

format.description: Identifies this JSON document as a PsMyBackup snapshot status.

schemaVersion.description: The version of the Backup Status Document Schema.

snapshotId.description: Unique snapshot ID in canonical GUID format (D).

snapshotPath.description: Absolute path of the snapshot directory on the system that created it.

startedAt.description: Backup start time in ISO 8601 / RFC 3339-compatible format with UTC offset.

finishedAt.description: Backup completion time; null while Status is Running.

filesCopied.description: Number of successfully copied files so far.

bytesCopied.description: Number of successfully copied bytes so far.

filesPlanned.description: Number of files identified for copying.

errors.description: Number of errors encountered during the backup.

fatalError.description: Fatal error message when present; otherwise null.
